search_text: published ZDI-24-899 ZDI-CAN-23078 Centreon testServiceExistence SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-07-15 CVE-2024-39841 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-39841 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Centreon'] ['Centreon'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Centreon. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the testServiceExistence function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the apache user. Fixed in centreon-web versions: 22.04.24, 22.10.22, 23.04.18, 23.10.12, 24.04.3 ['2024-02-22 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-07-15 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-08-15 - Advisory Updated'] cchav3z https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-899/
title: Centreon testServiceExistence SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Centreon. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the testServiceExistence function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the apache user.
